source_statement: Let ABCD be a convex quadrilateral. Extend line CD past D to meet line AB at P and extend line CB past B to meet line AD at Q. Suppose that line AC bisects ∠BAD. If AD = 47 , AP = 212 , and AB = 14 11 , compute AQ.

clause_ledger.dsl: A,B,C,D are constructed on the stated two intersecting line pairs with a positive-angle branch guard

clause_ledger.source: CD extended past D meets AB at P
clause_ledger.dsl: P is placed on the AB ray with AP=21/2 and C is the intersection of PD with AC

clause_ledger.source: CB extended past B meets AD at Q

clause_ledger.dsl: AB and AD are symmetric about the carrier line AC
